The '''Bogo Rai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Battle of Bogo Rai]].<ref name="The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
